title: DR-21: check own leaf at create; report others at join
description: Extends DR-15b (mimid-1wgh.4.45). Leaves already in a tree were not checked against the GroupContext required safe_aad/app_components lists. Readings: (a) refuse to create/join/observe any group with a non-conforming leaf; (b) check our own leaf at create (error), accept at join_welcome/join_external/Observer::from_group_info but report the indices of non-conforming existing leaves; (c) own leaf only. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-17: (b).
